answer: Align to KICD by keeping the 6-lesson storyline and making the coverage honest in wording, not by adding practicals. Remove the 'chemical structure' emphasis: keep the building blocks only as a brief one-line link (starch is a chain of glucose units) and drop amino acid and fatty acid/glycerol structure teaching. Record vitamin C test, catalase in living tissue and pH/substrate/enzyme-concentration as outcomes not yet covered; they need extra lessons (a new Lesson 7 or extension), which is larger than wording edits and needs the teacher to decide time. No data are invented.
alternative: Add a Lesson 7 practical (vitamin C test with DCPIP, catalase in liver/potato with hydrogen peroxide, and factors affecting enzymes: pH, substrate and enzyme concentration) and keep the existing six lessons unchanged.
knock_on: Lesson 4 summaryTablePrompt.learned and learnerExperience, Lesson 3 slo, and FE rubric still mention amino acids/fatty acids and building blocks; if a Lesson 7 is added, the FE needs new parts on vitamin C, catalase and enzyme factors.
